transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, what brought me in is that things just got really out of hand at work lately. I went from just being a normal crew guy doing landscaping to suddenly trying to run three different bids at once. I was calling city people, lining up plant suppliers, and... I just kept messaging everybody I knew about this big park idea I had. It was like I couldn't shut it off, you know? I just couldn't stop doing things.
How long has this burst of increased activity been going on?

Well, that whole fired-up stretch... it started right when I began trying to remake myself for that big park pitch. I guess I was just feeling really overconfident about the whole thing. It went on for about two weeks straight before I finally just crashed.
During that two-week period, were you using any alcohol, recreational drugs, or prescription medicines in a way that was different from usual?

No, I wasn't doing anything like that. I mean, I might have a beer now and then usually, but during those two weeks, I wasn't really drinking or taking anything. I didn't even think about it, honestly. I was just running purely on whatever was going on in my head.
Before this recent two-week period, had you ever experienced another distinct period when you felt unusually energized or overly confident like this?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had good days where I get a lot done at work, but nothing like this. This was... this was different. I've never felt that fired up or had that much energy going all at once before. Just this one time.
Did you need to be hospitalized because of this episode?
No, I didn't go to the hospital or anything like that. I just... I basically just stayed home once I finally crashed and couldn't keep going. But no, no hospitals.
During that two-week period, did your behavior cause serious disruption or major problems at work or in your relationships?

No, not really. I mean, I was definitely acting different, but it didn't really mess up my job or anything. I work outdoors mostly, doing landscaping, so having a lot of energy just meant I was working faster and harder. My boss actually seemed pretty happy about how much I was getting done. And with my friends or family... I guess I might have been talking a lot or seemed a bit intense, but nobody got mad at me or anything. It didn't cause any big fights or major problems, no.
